title: An ‘illusion of glitz and glamour’: Inside California’s modern-day gold rush, where miners can bring in millions
summary_full: The price of gold has sparked a modern-day gold rush in California. Small-scale miners are investing time, physical labor and money to unearth the yellow metal.
